title: The 2am Thought — you're not behind
hook: It's 2am, and your brain just whispered: everyone's ahead of you.
script: It's 2am, and your brain just whispered: everyone's ahead of you. You scroll, and it feels true. The promotions, the weddings, the people who figured it out. And you're still here, in the dark, feeling like you missed some starting gun everyone else heard. But here's what no one tells you about 2am thoughts. They're not facts. They're a tired brain running on fear, with the lights off and no evidence in the room. You are not behind. There is no line. There's just your life, moving at the speed a real life moves. Tomorrow, you don't have to win. You just have to begin. You're not behind. You're becoming.
